cards.exampleTranslation: Zhao Kuangyin established the Northern Song.
cards.breakdown: 建：拿着笔（聿），一步步走出去（廴）建造东西 · 立：一个人叉开双腿，稳稳站在地上

cards.exampleTranslation: The Northern Song established its capital at Bianjing.
cards.breakdown: 定：在屋子（宀）里稳稳地站定（疋），不再移动 · 都：聚集了所有人（者）的大城市（邑）

cards.exampleTranslation: The ruler of the Song was the emperor.
cards.breakdown: 君：手持权杖（尹），开口发号施令（口）

cards.exampleTranslation: The emperor controlled the army.
cards.breakdown: 控：用手（扌）掌握空间（空），不让它乱跑 · 制：用刀（刂）把乱长的树枝（未）修剪整齐，制定规矩

cards.example: 皇帝解除了将领的兵权。
cards.exampleTranslation: The emperor relieved the generals of their military power.
cards.breakdown: 解：用刀（刀）把牛角（角）从牛（牛）身上切开 · 除：把多余（余）的土堆（阝）铲掉，清除干净

cards.exampleTranslation: Military power was in the emperor's hands.
cards.breakdown: 权：手（又）握住大树（木）——掌握了力量

cards.exampleTranslation: The Song had a powerful army.
The imperial examination system was very important.
cards.breakdown: 制：用刀（刂）把乱长的树枝（未）修剪整齐，制定规矩

cards.exampleTranslation: The Jin Dynasty threatened the Northern Song.
cards.breakdown: 威：手持武器的士兵（戌）让人（女）感到恐惧和敬畏 · 胁：三股力量（劦）同时压向身体（月），迫使就范

cards.exampleTranslation: The Northern Song fell.
cards.breakdown: 灭：一横压在火上面，把火压灭了 · 亡：一个人躲进角落，藏起来不见了

cards.exampleTranslation: The country split into two parts.
cards.breakdown: 裂：衣服（衣）被撕裂，分成了一列一列（列）

cards.example: 皇帝举行了盛大的酒宴。
cards.exampleTranslation: The emperor held a grand banquet.
cards.breakdown: 宴：在屋子（宀）里，大白天（日）设宴款待宾客

cards.exampleTranslation: One could become an official through the imperial examination.
cards.breakdown: 举：大家一起用手把东西高高举起来

cards.exampleTranslation: The exam system selected talented people.

cards.example: 宋朝的价值观念重视教育。
cards.exampleTranslation: Song dynasty values emphasized education.
cards.breakdown: 值：一个人（亻）正直（直），所以有价值 · 观：睁大眼睛（见）仔细看，形成自己的看法 · 念：此刻（今）心里（心）想着的东西

cards.exampleTranslation: Wang Anshi carried out reforms.
cards.breakdown: 变：用行动（攵）打乱原来的样子，让它改变

cards.exampleTranslation: Wang Anshi was the prime minister of Song.
cards.breakdown: 宰：屋子（宀）里掌管一切辛苦事务（辛）的人 · 相：用眼睛（目）仔细观察树木（木），互相看清对方

cards.example: 变法改善了国家的财政。
cards.exampleTranslation: The reforms improved the state finances.
cards.breakdown: 财：有了钱财（贝），才（才）算有了资本 · 政：用行动（攵）维持正确（正）的秩序

cards.exampleTranslation: The government increased tax revenue.
cards.breakdown: 税：把粮食（禾）换成（兑）钱交给国家 · 收：用手（攵）把散落的东西收拢起来

cards.exampleTranslation: Many ministers opposed the reforms.
cards.breakdown: 反：手（又）用力向反方向推，把东西翻过来 · 对：用手（又）精确地（寸）对准目标

cards.exampleTranslation: Economic progress was very obvious.
cards.breakdown: 明：太阳（日）加月亮（月），两个都亮，当然明！ · 显：在阳光（日）下高高展示（业），一眼就能看见

cards.example: 城里有许多热闹的小巷。
cards.exampleTranslation: The city had many lively alleys.
cards.breakdown: 巷：大家共用（共）的蜿蜒小路（己）

cards.exampleTranslation: The Song dynasty economy was thriving.
cards.breakdown: 兴：大家一起（共）把东西高高托起来（臼），欣欣向荣 · 盛：盘子（皿）里盛满了成功（成）的果实

cards.back: fight; do battle; engage in war
cards.exampleTranslation: The army fought bravely.
cards.breakdown: 作：人（亻）突然（乍）动起来，开始做事 · 战：拿着武器（戈）与单独的对手（单）对打

cards.back: suffer a defeat; lose a battle
cards.exampleTranslation: The Song army suffered defeat and was forced to retreat.
cards.breakdown: 失：手里的东西从指缝间滑落，丢掉了 · 利：用刀（刂）割收庄稼（禾），收获利益

cards.exampleTranslation: The Jin troops attacked and seized Bianjing.
cards.breakdown: 攻：手持工具（工）主动出击（攵） · 占：插下旗帜（卜），大声宣告（口）这里是我的地盘

cards.exampleTranslation: The Jin troops carried off the emperor.
cards.breakdown: 掳：用手（扌）抓住俘虏（虏）带走

cards.example: 无能的官员让国家陷入危机。
cards.exampleTranslation: Incompetent officials led the country into crisis.
cards.breakdown: 无：古字像一个人跳舞，后来借用为'没有'的意思 · 能：像熊一样（月+匕匕），身体强壮，什么都能做

cards.exampleTranslation: The emperor governed the country.
cards.breakdown: 治：像治水（氵）一样，从高台（台）上统筹管理

cards.example: 皇帝和大臣们商量对策。
cards.exampleTranslation: The emperor discussed strategy with his ministers.
cards.breakdown: 臣：古字像一只眼睛向下看，表示臣子低头服从君主

cards.exampleTranslation: The Song dynasty began issuing paper currency.
cards.breakdown: 纸：用纤维（纟）为基础（氏）制成的薄片 · 币：古代用布帛（巾）当货币，后来专指钱

cards.example: 世界上最早的钞票出现在宋朝。
cards.exampleTranslation: The world's earliest banknotes appeared in the Song dynasty.
cards.breakdown: 钞：用少量的金属（钅）价值来代表大额的钱

cards.exampleTranslation: The government issued new paper currency.
cards.breakdown: 发：手拉弓（弓），两脚迈开（癶），把东西射发出去 · 行：左脚（彳）右脚（亍）交替迈出，走起来了

cards.example: 宋朝城市有各种娱乐活动。
cards.exampleTranslation: Song dynasty cities had all kinds of entertainment.
cards.breakdown: 娱：女子（女）载歌载舞，让人开心（吴） · 乐：古字像一架木制乐器上绑着丝弦，弹奏出美妙声音

cards.example: 岳飞成为了抗金的元帅。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yue Fei became the marshal leading resistance against the Jin.
cards.breakdown: 帅：手持旗帜（巾），让所有人俯首听命（卩）

cards.exampleTranslation: Yue Fei practiced martial arts from childhood.
cards.breakdown: 武：古义：能拿着武器（戈）让战争停止（止）才是真武 · 艺：像植物（艹）一样，从小慢慢（乙）长出来的本领

cards.exampleTranslation: Yue Fei was very hardworking.
cards.breakdown: 勤：像植物（堇）那样，默默用力（力）生长，从不懈怠 · 奋：像鸟（隹）从田野（田）上大力（大）振翅飞起

cards.exampleTranslation: Yue Fei achieved outstanding military merit.
cards.breakdown: 战：拿着武器（戈）与单独的对手（单）对打 · 功：用力气（力）努力干活（工），得到了功劳

cards.exampleTranslation: Yue Fei vowed to recover the lost territories.
cards.breakdown: 收：用手（攵）把散落的东西收拢起来 · 复：走回来，回到原来的地方

cards.exampleTranslation: The people all respected Yue Fei.
cards.breakdown: 尊：对长者（酋）恭敬地（寸）鞠躬行礼 · 敬：时刻督促（攵）自己谨慎认真（苟），表现出恭敬

cards.back: sue for peace; seek a truce
cards.exampleTranslation: The emperor wanted to sue for peace with the Jin.
Qin Hui ordered Yue Fei to withdraw his troops.
cards.breakdown: 退：遇到阻碍（艮），只好走（辶）回头

cards.exampleTranslation: The emperor recalled Yue Fei.
cards.breakdown: 召：张口呼唤（口），如刀声令下（刀），叫人过来

cards.exampleTranslation: Qin Hui falsely accused Yue Fei of treason.
cards.breakdown: 诬：像巫师（巫）一样，用语言（讠）施咒陷害别人 · 陷：在地形（阝）中挖坑，让人（臽）掉进去

cards.example: 岳飞品德高尚，受人爱戴。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yue Fei had noble character and was loved by all.
cards.breakdown: 品：三个人（口口口）一起品评，共同判断品质 · 德：每走一步（彳）都保持心地（心）正直（直）

cards.example: 宋朝人喜欢看杂技表演。
cards.exampleTranslation: Song dynasty people loved watching acrobatic shows.
cards.breakdown: 杂：许多（九）种树木（木）混杂在一起 · 技：用手（扌）熟练地操控各个分支（支）
